summary: ADR-0057 accepted 2026-08-05; knowledge publication owned only by maintain-knowledge-base with separate append-only request and explicit maintainer confirmation; request binds caller, trigger, one target plan, pinned local main commit, non-automatic status, timestamp, knowledge-publication authority, and hash-verified Acceptance stale route; publish_knowledge_catalog.py --publish fails closed without bindings or target at pinned main; Acceptance stale route is typed, hash-bound, non-authorizing, append-only in target plan; VDD/Acceptance reject outputs outside exact target directory; catalog indexes stable semantic plan sources only, excluding authority manifests and knowledge contexts to prevent recursive closure; standalone builder read-only, publication gate alone activates formal layers/pointers via validated capability; versioned top-level requirements/contract/state/command files select highest numeric version; requirements-ledger and requirements naming supported; historical generations remain compatible, new authorized publications record summary/hash; extends ADR-0044, ADR-0048, ADR-0050; no supersession
